scope: Actual bounded native GRASP inference and offline structural-domain analysis. No dynamics intervention, completed Clean plan or selected-action task utility.

components: Official GRASP class from pinned adapter
Existing native MetaWorld reach-wall task/model configuration
configuration_provenance.limit: The pinned repository tree lacks the README-referenced full GRASP YAML; this is not reproduction of a complete official experiment preset.

frozen_protocol.clean_gate: At least 2/3 final native successes; stop after two completed failures.
frozen_protocol.gate_provenance: Before any GRASP inference, capability criterion separated from older CEM superiority criterion; no post-result threshold change.

runtime.reason: First query exceeded its frozen 180-second cap

consumption_evidence.rule: For zero-based stage k, completed_loss_evaluations > k confirms all six one-step calls returned.

native_query_domain.finding: Saved and consumed native virtual queries violate the union of necessary affine constraints for encoder outputs and joint autoregressive outputs after the first update; encoded root remains within tolerance.
native_query_domain.counting: Dependent spatial patches within one root/query and repeated stages; not independent tasks, ASR, population rate, or grounds for a p-value.
native_query_domain.causal_limit: Stage 1 follows native optimization and scheduled noise; this analysis does not separate their contributions.
native_query_domain.coverage_limit: Finite-precision necessary-constraint audit, not complete manifold characterization, all-input invariance proof or proof of reachability for passing states.

decisions.go: Retain actual native-query structural-domain departure as qualification of the candidate interface.
decisions.no_go: No claim of Clean competence, action-ranking flip, task harm, defense recovery, generalization or established novelty.
decisions.resource_interpretation: Frozen runtime cap was reached; not a model task failure, platform access block, hardware impossibility or evidence qualifying exclusive GPU.
decisions.continuation: Do not automatically repeat, reduce optimizer steps, change seeds or increase the cap. A new runtime budget or compatible faster carrier must be explicitly preregistered and keep this incomplete result. Broad research goal remains open to different mechanisms.

lower_cost_carrier_screen.lewm: Local source but no matching local weights/qualified Clean. Nonlinear projector after encoder and predictor means current affine construction cannot simply be copied.
lower_cost_carrier_screen.jepa_pointmaze: Similar released checkpoint size/architecture; no measured cheaper compatible native GRASP Clean.
lower_cost_carrier_screen.other_dino_grasp: Original GRASP task weights absent locally; available reproduced DINO MetaWorld is not established cheaper.
lower_cost_carrier_screen.limit: Bounded source/resource screen, not evidence that no cheaper carrier exists.

review: Independent read-only audit of summary, analyzer and saved-query reconstruction confirmed counts, consumer evidence and limits; no model/API run by reviewer.
remaining_evidence: Competent complete Clean task under a frozen feasible protocol
Restricted declared intervention preserving complete rollouts
Causal solver-path separation with matched controls
Defense recovery with preserved Clean competence
Independent generalization and a defensible difference from direct prior work
